Unlike voxel grids, which require checking all cells, Ray-Rep allows skipping empty space and identifying only cells intersecting the surface, making it superior for adaptive triangulation and real-time editing of high-resolution details [S1].

The source [S1] explicitly states: 'В отличие от воксельной решётки, для триангуляции которой необходимо рассмотреть все ячейки, Ray-Rep позволяет быстро отбросить пустые участки пространства и идентифицировать только ячейки, пересекающие поверхность.' (Unlike a voxel grid, for triangulation of which it is necessary to consider all cells, Ray-Rep allows quickly discarding empty areas of space and identifying only cells intersecting the surface.) It further mentions that this skipping of empty space can be used to accelerate adaptive triangulation methods. Additionally, the source notes that real-time boolean operations and triangulation are possible on GPU for resolutions of 257-513 rays/voxels, supporting the 'real-time editing' aspect.
